chunks: If he has intercourse with her while she is menstruating, he should give charity to a needy person in an amount equal to that person's fill.

key_terms.حَائِضٌ: a woman in the state of menstruation
key_terms.شِبَعِهِ: his fill or satisfaction of hunger

ai.seo_question: What should be done if intercourse takes place while a woman is menstruating?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning intercourse during menstruation. It states that if this occurs, charity should be given to a needy person in an amount sufficient to satisfy hunger.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.200 - It is reported (from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) ) narrated:
'If a man has intercourse with a woman while She is menstruating, he should give charity to a needy person in an amount sufficient to satisfy their hunger.'.
